messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['I just went through your mail, I think you have all it takes to be employed for this job,', 'Upon your acceptance and willingness to stand as my trustee in handling this transaction, please do reply this mail, by contacting me strictly on this mail address as this mail using was the one myself and my husband were using when he was still alive.', 'On receipt of your response I will furnish you with detailed clarification as it relates to this mutual benefit transaction look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible if you are interested.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
